target: semantic equivalence of quantities, not requested answer-format compliance
routing: Rules inspect only full question/reference/candidate strings. No IDs, labels, saved decisions or confidence scores select the route.
matching: Exact rational equality after a fixed dimension-preserving conversion. No float epsilon, no universal rounding and no exchange-rate inference.
missing_units: Infer only from explicit recognized requested units in the question. Never borrow missing units merely from the reference or silently drop units.
percent: Each explicit % scales its own numeric value by 1/100. Bare answers to a percent request use percent units; 'of the total' is a dimensionless fraction.
context: Ambiguous/multiple requested units, unsupported compound units, dates/identifiers and rounding policies fall back.
whole_answer: No CoT mining, no selecting one number from prose, no deleting competing answers or negations.
fallback: Keep the unchanged legacy Qwen3-8B decision, including invalid/uncertain. Stored records are reused for this identical-input replay.
not_supported: general symbolic formulas and square roots
evaluation_scope: Already-inspected dev200 and probes20. Retrospective development comparison; not a new held-out benchmark.
